name: @shuv1337/pi-codex-runtime
description: First-class Pi coding-agent runtime sidecar for Codex

scripts.generate: shx mkdir -p src/gen && protoc -I proto --es_out src/gen --es_opt target=ts,import_extension=js proto/pi_codex_runtime.proto && biome check --write src/gen/pi_codex_runtime_pb.ts
scripts.build: npm run generate && tsgo -p tsconfig.build.json && shx chmod +x dist/cli.js
scripts.build:binary: npm run build && bun build --compile ./dist/cli.js --outfile dist/pi-codex-runtime
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run clean && npm run build

author: Earendil Works
